+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_search_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    q = params.get("q")
+    if not isinstance(q, str) or not q.strip():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid query"}
+    
+    found_users = users.search_users(q.strip())
+    return 200, {"users": found_users}

import pytest

    code, result = handle_search_users({"q": "Ada"})
    assert code == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 1
    assert result["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada Lovelace"

    # Test case-insensitive search
    code, result = handle_search_users({"q": "ada"})
    assert code == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 1
    assert result["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada Lovelace"

    assert handle_search_users({"q": "   "}).__getitem__(0) == 400
    assert handle_search_users({"q": 123}).__getitem__(0) == 400
